column1: Registration  of  Title Act, No.  21 of  1998
It is hereby notified that any person having a claim to the ownership or possession or interest to one or more of the parcels of lands re-
flected in the Cadastral Map No. 530029  made by the Surveyor-General under Section 11 of the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of
1998 relating to the village of Ambalanduwa (Block 02) or any part thereof, situated within the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 675A -
Ambalanduwa  in the Divisional Secretariat Division of Panadura in the District of Kalutara in the Province of Western should submit
his claim to the undersigned before 20th January, 2020 In the event of failure to submit any claim before the above-mentioned date,
action will be taken to hold an exparte inquiry to determine title to the land and accordingly publish such determination in the Govern-
ment Gazette in terms of Section 14 of the above Act.

T
he Cadastral Map No. 530029  referred to above may be perused at the relevant Grama Niladhari Office, Divisional Secretariat, Dis-
trict Survey Office, Office of the Commissioner of Title Settlement, or the Surveyor - General’s office.
